description: This Java source file defines a specific exception class, namely MessageMapperConfigurationFailedException, which is used to indicate failures in configuring a Message Mapper within the Eclipse Ditto framework. The class extends DittoRuntimeException and implements ConnectivityException, and includes builder methods for creating instances with detailed error information.
